name: 37406 · Chattanooga, TN
findings: ZIP 37406 (Chattanooga) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37406 (Chattanooga) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
